page.overview:
Who is Luigi de Filippis?

Luigi de Filippis (born 4 January 1922) is a former Italian racing driver. In , he finished 6th at the XIX Coppa Acerbo in a privately entered . He entered the 1950 Italian Grand Prix a few weeks later, but did not arrive at the circuit.
